Clinical Trial Manager (with Regulatory experience) 
 Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.  
 Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring a wide range of talented experts together across a wide range of business-critical services that support our business. Every role within Corporate is vital to furthering our vision of Shortening the Distance from Lab to Life®.
 
 Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know.
 
 WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE 
 
 Why Syneos Health
 We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
 We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people. 
 We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong. 
 
 Job Responsibilities 
 
 Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiological Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and with guidance develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
 Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
 For the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical project data review and capture Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements
 May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
 Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations
 Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
 For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt, with the oversight of the Lead CRA, to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
 May act as primary liaison with project site personnel, or in collaboration with another CRA or Central Monitoring Associate (CMA). Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
 Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
 Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
 For Real World Late Phase, the CRA I will use the business card title of Site Management Associate I. Additional responsibilities include: Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs Chart Abstraction activities and data collection Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff
 
 Qualifications:
 
 
 Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
 Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
 Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
 Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
 Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis

Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Job Title: Engineer - CMDB Data Quality
 GCL: C1/C2/C3
 Introduction to role:
 Are you ready to transform complex configuration data into trusted insight that powers critical services and, ultimately, helps patients receive life-changing medicines faster? Do you enjoy transforming messy datasets into reliable maps of how applications run, so teams can make faster, safer decisions?
 In this role you will be the engine behind the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will work with global colleagues across time zones to raise data standards, strengthen governance and deliver reliable configuration data for Incident, Change, Security and Asset processes. Your work will remove noise, reduce risk and give our technology and product teams the confidence to move at speed.
 From day one, you will own measurable improvements in CMDB health for priority classes and applications. As you scale your impact, you will shape automated controls, streamline certification cycles and provide the insights that steer remediation, modelling decisions and operational resilience.
 Accountabilities:
 CMDB Data Quality Monitoring and Standards: Monitor and improve health across key CI classes and domains, focusing on completeness, accuracy, compliance, freshness and relationships; define measurable targets, track trends and drive actions that move the metrics.
 Root Cause Analysis and Controls: Profile data, distinguish isolated vs. systemic issues and document causes; validate against the Data Dictionary; strengthen quality rules and controls to prevent recurrence.
 CI Remediation and Lifecycle Integrity: Eliminate duplicates, stale/orphaned CIs and shadow datasets; confirm operational status with owners, correct lifecycle states and retire records appropriately to keep the CMDB trustworthy.
 Discovery and Integration Quality: Monitor source-specific exceptions across ServiceNow Discovery, AWS, Azure, Intune, Tanium, VMware, Qualys, Wiz, Claroty and other sources; investigate identification and load anomalies; validate data after changes and engage SMEs for complex fixes.
 Service Mapping and Relationship Integrity: Assure the ongoing quality of maps for onboarded applications, identifying missing or broken relationships, stale dependencies and incorrect links; coordinate remediation with owners and track to closure.
 CSDM and Modelling Compliance: Review Business/Application Services and infrastructure CIs against modelling standards; flag non-compliance and missing links; coordinate corrections while partnering with SMEs on design decisions.
 Ownership, Certification and Governance: Validate CI ownership and support groups; coordinate periodic certification and attestations for CIs and service maps; track overdue actions, escalate through governance and retain evidence of completion.
 Build and maintain dashboards and governance reports on CMDB health, ownership, certification, and mapping. Explain issues, root causes, and required actions clearly to collaborators and leadership.
 Continuous Improvement and Automation: Identify recurring issues, recommend and operate automated classification, retirement and remediation controls; reduce manual effort and improve time-to-remediation.
 Essential Skills/Experience:
 Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data / Business Analytics, or equivalent experience.
 At least 3 years of relevant experience in IT Service Management, CMDB, IT asset or configuration management, technology operations, data quality or technology data analysis.
 Practical experience with ServiceNow CMDB, CMDB Health and reporting, including CI classes, attributes and relationships.
 Understanding of ITIL Configuration, Asset, Change and Incident processes and data-quality principles: completeness, accuracy, consistency and timeliness/freshness.
 Experience analysing large configuration, asset or technology data sets, identifying trends, and remediating data-quality issues using profiling, de-duplication, normalisation and root-cause analysis.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
 Experience developing operational reports and dashboards.
 Ability to collaborate across technology teams, drive stakeholder remediation and manage competing priorities independently.
 Clear written and verbal communication and documentation skills.
 Desirable Skills/Experience:
 Experience with CMDB 360, ServiceNow Data Manager, Certification and Predictive Intelligence.
 Knowledge of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, CSDM, Service Graph Connectors, and IRE and reconciliation.
 SQL/querying and Power BI or equivalent reporting skills; basic scripting or workflow automation experience.
 ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or CMDB micro-certifications.
 Experience in biopharmaceuticals, life sciences or another regulated environment.
 Experience working across cultures and time zones, including a Global Technology Centre operating model.
 Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.
 When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn t mean we re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
 Why AstraZeneca:
 Here, technology and science meet at scale to make a tangible difference for patients. You will join an inclusive, cross-functional community that pairs deep domain expertise with modern platforms, data and AI to remove friction, simplify processes and unlock speed across the enterprise. We back bold ideas with real investment, value kindness alongside ambition, and give you the ownership to experiment, learn and deliver lasting impact. Job Title: Senior Analyst-Publication Writer
 Career Level:D1
 About AstraZeneca 
 AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.
 Introduction to role: 
 Are you ready to lead sophisticated, high-stakes scientific publications that shape clinical understanding and guide decision the role of Lead Publication Writer at Manyata Tech Park, Bengaluru, you will create clear and compliant narratives from robust evidence. These narratives will support advancing patient outcomes and advise the scientific community.unity.
 You will own the path from first outline to acceptance for priority scientific papers and presentation content, aligning contributors and navigating disclosure nuances with confidence. Collaborating alongside biostatistics, drug development, medical, and external author teams, you will drive publication delivery end-to-end, strengthening the visibility and impact of our therapies. We collaborate in person on average three days per week to connect, move at pace, and challenge perspectives—do you thrive on bringing diverse experts together to deliver publication excellence?
 Accountabilities :
 Publication leadership: Independently manage sophisticated articles and conference materials within assigned publication plans, from initial prioritisation and planning through submission and resubmission. Coordinate contributors, manage timelines and dependencies, and call out significant scientific, quality, or delivery risks appropriately.
 Scientific writing, editing, and review: Author and critically review sophisticated manuscripts, structured abstracts, posters, and presentations, including publications based on clinical trials, subgroup analyses, real-world evidence, and health economics and outcomes research. Develop clear scientific narratives and ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with specifications for written and oral scientific forums.
 Sophisticated disclosure management: Develop document outlines, figure and table shells, and evidence flow for sophisticated assigned deliverables. Manage publication systems, document versions, dependencies, and stakeholder inputs while maintaining alignment with the agreed publication strategy.
 Data interpretation: Work with biostatistics, clinical, safety, and medical colleagues to interpret datasets and analytical outputs for assigned publications. Identify and reconcile inconsistencies across source documents and ensure that conclusions accurately reflect the available evidence.
 Literature review and evidence synthesis: Plan and conduct literature searches and evidence reviews supporting assigned publications. Maintain methodological rigour, transparent search documentation, accurate reference libraries, and citation integrity.
 Publication and conference presentation submissions: Prepare and coordinate complete submission packages, cover letters, and responses to reviewer comments. Manage author approvals, disclosures, and compliance checks, and resolve routine journal or congress queries.
 Translate scientific data into detailed, clear, and suitably tailored figures and tables. Work with design partners to develop publication-ready visual assets that meet journal, congress, accessibility, and brand requirements.
 Compliance and publication ethics: Apply Good Publication Practice, ICMJE recommendations, AstraZeneca policies, and relevant transparency requirements across assigned deliverables. Identify potential concerns and escalate sophisticated ethical or compliance questions to the appropriate experts.
 Content strategy and stakeholder management: Contribute to asset publication strategies and lead author meetings and cross-functional reviews for assigned deliverables. Clarify expectations, consolidate feedback, and maintain alignment on scope, scientific narrative, and timelines.
 Project delivery and documentation: Plan and manage schedules, dependencies, and documentation for multiple concurrent deliverables. Maintain accurate, audit-ready records in publication management systems and recommend practical improvements to quality, consistency, and efficiency.
 Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with clinical development, medical affairs, biostatistics, HEOR, safety, regulatory, external authors, and other publication stakeholders. Represent Publication Delivery in forums directly related to assigned deliverables and support congress planning activities as required.
 Digital innovation: Use approved artificial intelligence, automation, and digital tools responsibly to improve publication quality and efficiency. Contribute user insight and participate in pilots, adoption activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
 Quality and consistency: Apply established quality-control requirements, conduct peer reviews, and provide clear, actionable feedback. Ensure consistency across related deliverables and alignment with source materials, product information, and previous disclosures.
 Capability building: Develop strong subject-matter expertise in assigned therapeutic areas. Provide day-to-day coaching, peer review, and practical guidance to Publication Writers, and contribute to onboarding, training materials, and team learning activities.
 Essential Skills/Experience: 
 Master’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, biochemistry, biotechnology, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline.
 Four to six years of experience in medical or scientific writing, including demonstrated leadership of complex manuscripts and congress disclosures; or, where industry experience is more limited, significant and credible academic research and publication experience, including authorship of complex original research published in highly reputed peer-reviewed journals.
 Advanced understanding of clinical research methods, biostatistics, scientific communication, and publication ethics, including Good Publication Practice and ICMJE recommendations.
 Demonstrated ability to interpret complex data and translate scientific evidence into accurate, clear, and audience-appropriate publications.
 Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and organisational skills, with the ability to lead multiple high-priority projects.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office, reference management tools, and publication management platforms, together with familiarity with data visualisation standards.
 Desirable Skills/Experience: 
 Advanced degree such as PharmD, PhD, MD, or MPH, or a recognised qualification in medical writing or communications.
 Experience leading integrated disclosures involving pooled analyses, meta-analyses, HEOR, or epidemiology, and coordinating multi-author manuscripts through acceptance.
 Experience in one or more of the following therapeutic areas: Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism; Respiratory and Immunology; Vaccines and Immune Therapies.
 Experience collaborating with investigators, external experts, and cross-functional teams, including engagement with journal editors and congress secretariats.
 Strong working knowledge of authorship criteria, data transparency, data-sharing expectations, and journal and congress submission systems.
 Why AstraZeneca? 
 At AstraZeneca, we re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.
 When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn t mean we re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

 Minimum 4 Year / Bachelor s degree in computer science, information 
 technology, engineering, or related field.

 5 years of experience in enterprise application engineering, solution architecture, technical leadership, or related technology roles.

 Experience leading architecture, solution design, development, testing, deployment, integration, and ongoing support across multiple products. 
 Experience delivering technology supporting sales, marketing, and deal-management processes, including: 
 
 Prospecting, account planning, opportunity management, pipeline, and forecasting. 
 Campaigns, account-based marketing, lead management, digital engagement, and attribution. 
 Proposals, RFPs, pricing, approvals, contracting, and document generation. 
 
 
 Strong experience with Salesforce or a comparable enterprise CRM, including platform architecture, security, automation, data models, APIs, and integrations.

Job Title: Senior Data Integration Analyst 
 
 Location: Hyderabad 
 About the job   Our Hubs are a crucial part of how we innovate, improving performance across every Sanofi department and providing a springboard for the amazing work we do. Join our Hyderabad Hub, build a career and you can be part of transforming our business while helping to change millions of lives. Ready?  As Senior Data Integration Analyst within our Hyderabad Hub, you will play a key role in the integration of data collected through clinical trials, contributing significantly to implementing tools to enhance data flow management. Your responsibilities will include the implementation of data flows and data mapping to meet the organization s clinical data hub standards and ensuring compliance with GCP and applicable regulatory guidelines. You will ensure that all activities are completed according to agreed-upon standards and timelines, while also providing support to guarantee the accuracy and reliability of the data. We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We’re also a company where you can flourish and grow your career, with countless opportunities to explore, make connections with people, and stretch the limits of what you thought was possible. Ready to get started? Main responsibilities  
 Accountability for the quality of CDM data integration deliverables (such as FTS (File Transfer Specification), DTA (Data Transfer Agreement), Data Mapping specification and implementation) and for the delivery of accurate and reliable clinical study data.
 Coordinating study data integration activities for the data flow implementation with external providers and internal stakeholders: specifications, implementation, testing including data collected through Central Labs, eCOA, IRT, connected devices, telemedicine, HR, and mobile healthcare.
 Liaising directly with internal customers (Clinical Data Manager, Global Study Manager, Study Medical Manager, Statistician, Quality, etc.) and external providers to coordinate all clinical data integration activities for studies and discussing timelines.
 Proactively anticipating and addressing data integration issues arising during study conduct and monitoring them until resolution.
 Identifying areas for continuous improvement and actively participating.
 Analyzing new requirements from customers and proposing technical solution strategies.
 Providing support in the implementation of specific data flows and offering assistance to new Data Integration Analysts.
   About you  
 At least 3 years’ experience in clinical data management and more than 1 years in external data integration and mapping.
 Good collaboration and communication skill. Strong experience with CDM and related regulations (incl. ICH E6 and E8).
 Solid risk-based mindset focusing on Quality by Design (QbD) and on what really matters.
 Learn and adapt quickly when facing new problems. Think critically and use rigorous, objective, and pragmatic methods to solve multidimensional problems with effective and timely solutions.
 Experienced in CDISC standards /terminologies in Clinical Data Standards. Good knowledge in data transfer and data mapping using digital tools.
 Anticipate delivery risks, bottlenecks, issues, and delays to proactively prevent them or minimize their impact.
 Understanding of advanced drug development concepts such as Decentralized Clinical Trials (DCT), Master & Adaptive Protocols, eSource. Programming languages (SAS, R or Python) and AI Based automations is a plus.
 Bachelor or Master of Science degree or above, preferably in a life science or mathematics-related area (e.g., Pharmaceutical, medical, or mathematics, computer science or similar technical fields).
 Strong English skills (verbal and written), ability to exchange fluently in a global environment.
   Why choose us?    Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team. Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally. Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact. Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave. Join an international innovative biopharma company. Lead a clinical data technology team working on several therapeutic areas. Participate in the evolution of Clinical Data Management and deployment of innovations

jobs.description:
Title: Specialist- Commercial Reporting & Analytics (CRA) 
 Career Level: D2
 Role purpose Provide end-to-end operational and commercial coordination for CRA, connecting Service Leads, GPOs, Finance and leadership to deliver accurate workforce reporting, recharge management, financial insight and executive governance.
 About AstraZeneca 
 AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.
 Introduction to role:
 Are you prepared to lead the functional and fiscal rhythm of a sophisticated, multi-service analytics organization? You will turn fragmented inputs into clear decisions that move the business forward. Do you thrive on connecting people, processes and data to create a reliable foundation that leaders trust?
 Serving as the CRA Operations Supervisor, you will anchor the monthly operating cadence and quarterly leadership reporting that underpin investment choices, personnel planning and commercial recovery. Your work will convert detailed workforce, demand, recharge and cost information into concise narratives and actions that drive productivity, fund priority work and ultimately help bring medicines to patients faster.
 You will partner closely with Service Leads, Finance, process owners and business collaborators to strengthen controls, improve data quality and evolve charging models as services scale. From day one, you will set the pace for reliable submissions, sharp variance explanations and proactive risk management that builds confidence across the leadership team.
 Accountabilities:
 Recharge and commercial management: Lead the end-to-end recharge cycle across services, ensuring accurate inputs, validated assumptions and reconciliations to volumes, workforce plans and approved cases. Prevent missed recovery, maintain audit-ready models and support the shift from FTE-based to volume-based charging.
 Workforce planning and FTE governance: Own monthly FTE actuals and forecasts, coordinating hiring, attrition, internal moves and phasing. Explain variances versus budget and plan, keep approvals current, and align capacity with demand, utilization, efficiency and recharge outcomes.
 Financial operations and P&L support: Provide analytical support on labor, third-party spend, internal recharges and efficiency. Track purchase orders and accruals, prepare reconciliations and schedules, and surface risks, opportunities and corrective actions for monthly reviews and planning cycles.
 Benefits, efficiency and business-case governance: Maintain consolidated tracking of benefit delivery, insourcing and efficiency initiatives. Validate assumptions and outcomes with collaborators, align reporting across workforce, recharge and P&L, and highlight realization risks early with practical mitigations.
 Operational and executive reporting: Produce a complete, consistent monthly operational and commercial pack and coordinate leadership reporting on a quarterly basis. Translate sophisticated detail into decision-focused summaries that explain movements, implications and required actions, and drive data consistency and automation across systems and dashboards.
 Collaborator and governance leadership: Act as the central coordination point across Finance, Service Leads, key process coordinators, and Business Leads. Manage a clear calendar for data collection, validation, submission, and follow-up. Lead governance reviews, oversee actions to closure, and influence without authority to set a higher standard for data accuracy and completeness.nes.
 Crucial Skills/Experience:
 8-12 years of meaningful experience in operations management, business operations, commercial operations, finance operations, PMO, workforce planning, shared services or a comparable cross-functional role.
 Demonstrated experience with cost allocation, recharges, budgeting, forecasting, accruals, commercial analysis or P&L support.
 Experience consolidating inputs from multiple teams and presenting accurate reporting to senior collaborators.
 Solid understanding of arguments, benefits realization, productivity measurement and governance processes.
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience or equivalent confirmed experience in finance, business, operations, analytics or a related rigor.
 Commercial and financial competence, with understanding of P&L drivers, labor and third-party costs, recharges, accruals, forecasts and arguments.
 Analytical thinking, with the ability to reconcile sophisticated datasets, identify anomalies, test assumptions and explain variances clearly.
 Collaborator influence, building trusted relationships and influencing senior collaborators without direct authority.
 Executive communication, developing simple, clear summaries from detailed operational and financial information.
 Planning and control, running recurring cycles reliably, maintaining documentation and handling high-reaching deadlines.
 Digital fluency with sophisticated Excel capability and confident use of PowerPoint and Power BI.
 Continuous improvement attitude to simplify processes, strengthen controls and advance reporting automation and data quality.
 Desirable Skills/Experience:
 Familiarity with Jira and ServiceNow.
 Experience supporting the transition from fixed headcount billing to usage-based charging, including service catalogues and true-up mechanisms.
 Background in shared services, global operations or multi-service environments with sophisticated collaborator landscapes.
 Proven track record establishing a single source of truth across multiple systems and driving automation in operational and finance reporting.
 Exposure to third-party spend analytics, purchase-order lifecycle management and quarter-end readiness.
 Why AstraZeneca:
 Here, innovative thinkers and problem-solvers come together to tackle complex challenges with urgency and care, uniting diverse perspectives to unlock bold ideas that make a real difference for patients. You will work shoulder to shoulder with experts across subject areas, with the tools, data and support to test assumptions, take smart risks and turn insights into action. We value kindness alongside ambition, bringing unexpected teams into the same room to challenge convention and build resilient solutions that scale—so your contribution directly powers breakthroughs in science and the business systems that support it.
 When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn t mean we re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

About the job
  
 Our Team: 
  
 The Global R&D Strategy and Portfolio Management team s overarching objective is to equip Sanofi s leaders with robust, objective and externally focused insights and recommendations they need to make better informed R&D strategy, and portfolio and project investment decisions to ensure pipeline sustainability.
  
 We achieve this by (1) delivering a comprehensive R&D strategy positioning the organization to embrace future opportunities and challenges, driving sustained success (2) ensuring a sustainable portfolio strategy, robust valuation and prioritization of the R&D portfolio and optimization of resources, high quality pipeline reporting, benchmarking, and scientific competitive intelligence (3) ensuring high quality investment governance incorporating decision quality and thoughtful risk taking principles.
  
 As part of the R&D Portfolio Strategy and Management team, the Competitive Intelligence group works with key stakeholders across the organization (R&D and GBUs) to deliver robust external competitive intelligence insights and ensure data-driven decision-making.
  
 We are seeking a dynamic Competitive Intelligence Analyst to join our team at our offshore hub in India. In this role, you will collect, analyze, and synthesize scientific information from a wide range of sources to generate actionable insights related to diseases, products, and technologies. These insights will support the competitive positioning of Sanofi s assets and help identify emerging risks and opportunities within the external landscape.
 This position offers the opportunity to deepen expertise in competitive analysis, contribute to high-impact projects, and collaborate with global stakeholders across R&D and commercial functions. You will work closely with senior CI analysts and leads as part of a global team supporting R&D strategy.
   
 Main responsibilities: 
  
 • Analyze multiple sources of intelligence to identify relevant and reliable competitive data and assimilate it in standard deliverables. Projects may include, but are not limited to, competitive landscapes (target, disease, or technology), pipeline analyses, clinical trial tracking, company profiling, conference coverage, etc.
  
 • Generate reports providing data analysis and visualizations that meet high quality standards; work under the supervision of the CI leader and/or CI Senior Analyst to refine the content and translate into actionable insights.
  
 • Proactively monitor top competitors and timely communicate analysis and insights from key updates. Ensure that stakeholders participating in governance decision-making meetings have an up-to-date view of the relevant competitive situation.
  
 • Collaborate closely with R&D Portfolio Analytics and Benchmarking teams, including contributions to industry benchmarks, ad-hoc competitive deep dives, and scenario analyses as needed.
  
 • Assist in the evaluation and implementation of new CI tools and platforms, including digital and AI-based solutions. Support the team in maintaining CI knowledge repositories.
  
  
 About you 
 Skills that you have: 
 Experience: ≥3 years of experience in pharmaceuticals industry, specifically within innovative pharma. ≥3 years experience in Competitive Intelligence within a pharma company or a CI agency conducting secondary data analysis and surveillance of R&D assets (pipeline drugs, technology platforms, clinical trials). Exposure to Sanofi s therapeutic areas (Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicine) a plus.
  
 Soft skills: 
  
 • High learning agility and a high degree of curiosity with a focus on detail and accuracy
 • Team player who is dynamic, result-oriented, and collaborative
 • Excellent interpersonal skills; ability to work effectively with diverse teams across geographies and functions
 • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and ensure priorities and timelines are met
  
 Technical skills: 
  
 • Solid understanding of drug discovery and development processes
 • Strong research and analytical capabilities in aggregating information from multiple sources, and summarizing key points
 • Experience in using online data sources (e.g., Pubmed, clinicaltrials.gov) and pharma CI databases (e.g., Citeline, Evaluate Pharma, Cortellis)
 • Familiarity with clinical data, regulatory frameworks and trial designs is preferred
 • Good written and oral communication skills with ability to present complex information clearly and concisely
 • Analytical agility to shift between different therapeutic areas, competitors and intelligence topics as business priorities evolve
 • MS-office skills (MS-Excel and MS-PowerPoint)
  
 Education: Master s degree or higher in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or related field
  
 Languages: English (all data, reports and interactions with business stakeholders are managed in English)
